summary: OUTFRONT Media filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, furnishing third-quarter 2026 results via Item 2.02 and announcing under Item 8.01 that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.33 per share, payable December 31, 2026, to holders of record December 4, 2026. Reported figures include revenues of $511.1 million, operating income of $102.8 million, net income attributable to the company of $64.8 million, Adjusted OIBDA of $145.3 million, and AFFO of $102.9 million. No advisors, premiums, or transactional mechanics are disclosed; this is routine earnings and dividend reporting, not a special situation, with no deal-risk arbitrage angle.
